name: Terminus Reach: Sentinel 2
source:
5 years have passed since the assault on Sentinel station, time of rebuilding, time of peace. But now new shadows looms in the horizon, and once again the Wraith has to step up and fight for his beloved.

[From [url=https://talothral.blogspot.com/2022/04/public-release-terminus-reach-sentinel-2.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
距离哨兵站遭到袭击已经过去了5年，这是重建时期，也是和平时期。但现在新的阴影出现在地平线上，幽灵必须再次挺身而出，为他心爱的人而战。

[来自[url=https://talothral.blogspot.com/2022/04/public-release-terminus-reach-sentinel-2.html]官方网站[/url]]
